groups.defect: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities treats an undefined rule (skipToken) as AlwaysSupported, so Duplicate can be granted and, OR-ed with the ruler ability in AlertRuleMenu, wrongly shown for cloud rules.

answer.reasoningPt: S3 e S6 apontam o mesmo defeito: com rule indefinida (skipToken), loading=false deixa MaybeSupported como AlwaysSupported, e Duplicate aparece para regras cloud por causa do OR no AlertRuleMenu. As duas propõem a mesma correção (!rule || loading ? NotSupported : AlwaysSupported), então o grupo se mantém.
